question: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town whose current population of 2,50,000 is increasing at a rate of 25% every year?
solution:
**Given:**

Current population = ₹2,50,000

Growth rate = 25% per year

Find: Difference between population 3 years ago and 2 years ago

**Formula used:**

Population n years ago = Current × (4/5)ⁿ (since 1 / 1.25 = 4/5)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Population 3 years ago = 250000 × (4/5)³

⇒ Population 3 years ago = 250000 × 64/125

⇒ Population 3 years ago = 128000

⇒ Population 2 years ago = 250000 × (4/5)²

⇒ Population 2 years ago = 250000 × 16/25

⇒ Population 2 years ago = 160000

⇒ Difference = 160000 - 128000

⇒ Difference = 32000

**∴ Difference = 32,000**
